page.overview:
Who is Assum Emring?

Seeker Assum Emring is a halfling ranger who held the title of Master of Information on the Council of Tal'Dorei in Emon. As an NPC, he is played by Matthew Mercer.

Assum wears ranger garb, a fine mail shirt, and a thick, dark, black cloak. He has tattoos covering one side of his face. Normally, his head is shaved bald, but since the attack of the Chroma Conclave, his hair has grown in and acid scarring has covered some of his tattoos.

Assum used to be a member of the Clasp, but was able to leave and erase almost all trace of his membership of the theives' guild. In his first meeting with Sovereign Uriel Tal'Dorei II, Assum's defiant demeanor almost had him arrested. However the next day, the sovereign instead offered Assum the position of Master of Information on the Tal'Dorei Council.

Assum appeared alongside the other members of the Council of Tal'Dorei to decide what to do with the Horn of Orcus that Vox Machina brought back from the Underdark. Assum said little during the discussion, but his body language indicated that he had heard of illithid before and, like the rest of the Council, was worried about the Horn.
